hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$f = '$CLAUDE_TOOL_RESULT_FILE'; if ($f -match 'index\.html$' -or $f -match 'unidade-\d+\.html$') { $content = Get-Content $f -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($content -and $content -notmatch '<!DOCTYPE html>') { Write-Error 'AVISO: arquivo HTML sem DOCTYPE' } else { Write-Host 'HTML OK' } }"
hooks.description: Valida DOCTYPE em arquivos HTML editados
